Rescue Recoil Chain.name: Rescue Recoil Chain
Rescue Recoil Chain.description: The user carries one adult with their free arm and releases three precisely metered shots during a single leap, steering through open air up to thirty meters and braking onto a visible landing before the end of their next turn. Each shot needs an empty impact area below or behind them; the user cannot hover, and a missed impulse spoils the landing. Afterward the user's shaking arm cannot fire for the rest of the scene, and they need help carrying the rescued person. Strain: severe.
